# Introduction

Welcome to Vanderbilt's Biostatistics Graduate Program! We are so happy you are here. This is an UNOFFICIAL survival guide written by students for students in the Vanderbilt Biostatistics program. Thank you to the starred authors for getting this book started! 

We hope this helps incoming students transition to our department more smoothly and serves as a reference for senior students. Graduate students throughout the history of the program have compiled our best & wildest advice into a beautiful [bookdown](https://bookdown.org/yihui/bookdown/) book. ENJOY (or else...)


:::: {style="display: flex;"}

::: {width=80%}

The original version of this book was written prior to 2020, and current BGSA leadership are in the process of revamping it with our most up-to-date advice. Email [Ashley Mullan](mailto:ashley.e.mullan@vanderbilt.edu) if you catch anything that needs an update.

:::

The student handbook code is on GitHub [here](https://github.com/vandybgsa/handbook). You can contribute by starting a new issue, modifying a page, adding a new page, or emailing BGSA leadership and asking them to do it for you!  See $\S$ \@ref(github) to get started with GitHub.
